name: mnemonic_void_hum_feedback
label: The Hum of Absence
godotFeature: AudioServer, AudioStreamGenerator, AudioEffectEQ, AudioEffectFilter (dynamic bus manipulation)
poeticVision: The player feels an invasive, phantom ache in their ears, a growing hum that grinds against their very being, marking each forgotten piece of self. It's the sound of a hole in existence, a siren call to the hunters, and a constant, growing pressure that makes every step a struggle against an internal enemy composed of what is no longer there.
usage: Attach this script to any Node in your scene. It will automatically create an AudioStreamPlayer and configure a dedicated audio bus ('VoidHumBus' by default) with EQ and Filter effects. To control the 'Hum of Absence', simply update the 'memory_loss_level' property from another script (e.g., `get_node("Path/To/MnemonicVoidHumFeedback").memory_loss_level = new_value`). The hum's intensity, dissonance, and the disorienting audio effects will dynamically adjust based on this level. Fine-tune the hum's characteristics and effect parameters using the exported variables in the Inspector.

parameters.name: memory_loss_level
parameters.description: Current level of memory loss, from 0 (no loss) to 1 (max loss). Controls intensity and disorientation of the hum and effects.

parameters.name: bus_name
parameters.description: Name of the audio bus used for the hum and its effects. A new bus will be created if it doesn't exist.

parameters.name: base_hum_frequency
parameters.description: Base frequency of the procedurally generated hum in Hz.

parameters.name: hum_frequency_range
parameters.description: Maximum deviation from the base frequency for modulation, scaled by memory loss.

parameters.name: hum_amplitude_mod_speed
parameters.description: Speed of the amplitude modulation (pulsation) of the hum.

parameters.name: hum_frequency_mod_speed
parameters.description: Speed of the frequency modulation (pitch wobble) of the hum.

parameters.name: dissonance_factor
parameters.description: Factor determining how much a second, detuned wave is added for dissonance, scaled by memory loss.

parameters.name: max_eq_gain_db
parameters.description: Maximum additional gain applied to specific EQ bands as memory loss increases, making the sound more 'grinding'.

parameters.name: min_filter_cutoff_hz
parameters.description: Minimum low-pass filter cutoff frequency at max memory loss (more muffled/disorienting).

parameters.name: max_filter_cutoff_hz
parameters.description: Maximum low-pass filter cutoff frequency at min memory loss (less muffled).

parameters.name: filter_resonance
parameters.description: Base resonance of the low-pass filter. Resonance increases with memory loss, making the filter effect more pronounced.

verdict: A haunting symphony of self-erasure, this invention transforms the silent void of forgetting into a visceral, inescapable hum that echoes both Lyra's internal decay and the encroaching shadow of the Silence.
impact: This invention will fundamentally deepen the player's immersion in Lyra's struggle. The 'Hum of Absence' transforms the abstract concept of memory loss into a constant, invasive, and terrifying auditory presence. It will serve as a relentless, internal antagonist, making every moment a visceral battle against self-dissolution. The hum's dual role as a marker of internal decay and a 'siren call' for external hunters ensures that the player feels perpetually hunted, amplifying the core themes of urgency, desperation, and the profound cost of forgetting. It creates a unique, unforgettable sensory feedback loop that ties directly into the game's core mechanics and narrative.
